execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."CartStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'ABANDONED', 'CONVERTED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."DiscountType" AS ENUM ('PERCENTAGE', 'FIXED_AMOUNT')
CREATE TYPE "public"."OrderStatus" AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."PaymentMethod" AS ENUM ('AMERICAN_EXPRESS', 'APPLE_PAY', 'DINERS_CLUB', 'DISCOVER', 'GOOGLE_PAY', 'MASTERCARD', 'SHOP_PAY', 'VISA')
CREATE TYPE "public"."PaymentStatus" AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."ProductStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."ShipmentStatus" AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'DELIVERED', 'RETURNED', 'CANCELLED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UserStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."role_name" AS ENUM ('CUSTOMER', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'ORDER_MANAGER', 'CONTENT_MANAGER')

CREATE TABLE "public"."addresses" (
  "address_line1" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "address_line2" character varying(255),
  "city" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "country" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "postal_code" character varying(20),
  "state" character varying(100),
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cart_items" (
  "cart_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "product_variant_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "unit_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."carts" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "status" "CartStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"CartStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."categories" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "image_url" character varying(255),
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "parent_id" int4,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."contact_messages" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "subject" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."coupons" (
  "code" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discount_type" "DiscountType" NOT NULL,
  "discount_value" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamp(3),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customers" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(20),
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "reserved_quantity" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "variant_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."newsletter_subscribers" (
  "email" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "subscribed_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_coupons" (
  "coupon_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discount_amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "order_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("order_id", "coupon_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_items" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "order_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "product_name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sku" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "total_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "unit_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "variant_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orders" (
  "billing_address_line1" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "billing_address_line2" character varying(255),
  "billing_city" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "billing_country" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "billing_name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "billing_phone" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "billing_postal_code" character varying(20),
  "billing_state" character varying(100),
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "discount_amount" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "shipping_address_line1" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "shipping_address_line2" character varying(255),
  "shipping_city" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "shipping_country" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "shipping_fee" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "shipping_name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "shipping_phone" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "shipping_postal_code" character varying(20),
  "shipping_state" character varying(100),
  "status" "OrderStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"OrderStatus" NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payments" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "order_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "payment_method" "PaymentMethod" NOT NULL,
  "status" "PaymentStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"PaymentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "transaction_ref" character varying(100),
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."permissions" (
  "code" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(255),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product_images" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "image_url" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "product_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product_variants" (
  "color" character varying(50),
  "compare_at_price" numeric(10,2),
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "product_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "size" character varying(50),
  "sku" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "status" "ProductStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"ProductStatus" NOT NULL,
  "style" character varying(50),
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."products" (
  "category_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "status" "ProductStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"ProductStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reviews" (
  "comment" text,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "product_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."role_permissions" (
  "assigned_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "permission_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "role_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("role_id", "permission_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."roles" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(255),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" "role_name" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shipments" (
  "carrier" character varying(50),
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "delivered_at" timestamp(3),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "order_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "shipped_at" timestamp(3),
  "status" "ShipmentStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"ShipmentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "tracking_number" character varying(100),
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_roles" (
  "assigned_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "role_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "role_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "last_login_at" timestamp(3),
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "status" "UserStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"UserStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
